name: Experiment Kraj — depends on Turn to Frog making the countered creature lose all abilities
notes: Turn to Frog on a Llanowar Elves with a +1/+1 counter takes away the ability Kraj would gain. Kraj's layer-6 effect depends on Turn to Frog's (CR 613.8a: applying Turn to Frog changes what Kraj's effect does), so it waits, and Kraj gains nothing; the same as with Darksteel Mutation.

$includes: {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
